module.outlineDatum: centered on mean of main header pad centers; exact pin-to-outline offset remains unmeasured
module.headerSeating: Both board faces seat against the 2.54 mm header collars; module header-face Z = carrier underside Z - collar height.
module.holeDiameterBasis: Unmeasured V3.0 clearance assumption. The comparative V3.1 STEP has 0.9 mm holes; no interchangeability or guaranteed fit with the selected square pins is claimed.

switch.limitation: Nominal geometric motion only. Switch pretravel is not an allowable overtravel specification. Installed gap, switch height and printed tolerance require adjustment before load testing.

fasteners.limitation: Screws use catalog clearance envelopes; nuts use nominal clearance bores without modeled threads. Axial engagement is calculated and audited when supported; thread strength, tightening torque and printed boss strength are not verified.
fasteners.screwGeometry: KernelCAD local ISO 4762 catalog, detail=envelope; lengths 8 and 20 mm
fasteners.driverAccessLimitation: A straight 4 mm-diameter shaft corridor is reserved from above. The actual tool, its recess engagement and hand clearance are not selected or validated.

directUsb.limitation: Direct-access proposal. The inspected male overmold is real; module USB center, mating-plane datum and fully seated shoulder offset remain assumptions. No internal extension or selected flexible cable routing is claimed.
directUsb.centerZBasis: module component face minus half the provisional receptacle height; exact connector datum remains unmeasured

speakerReservation.reason: Moves the unselected speaker envelope clear of the lower carrier screw heads and button support.

displayStack.limitation: Original nominal LCD height envelope is retained. Connector height, PCB/component thickness and screen retention need the purchased module dimensions; only XY outline and active area are manufacturer sourced.

J1.limitation: Wire exit volume is a design reservation, not a measured harness route or a specified bend radius.

omissions: C1 and C2 capacitor bodies and leads
Most switch terminal tails and solder joints
Full LCD harness, wire bends, strain relief and connector seating
Exact purchased V3.0 board-to-header and USB mating datums
Final LCD retention and connector height
Battery, protection/charging circuit and selected speaker
